message.content:
「2020 年的總統大選」這個說法在不同國家會有完全不一樣的答案。  
以下是兩個最常被提及的例子，您可以告訴我是哪一位：

| 國家 | 選舉年份 | 獲勝者 |
|------|----------|--------|
| 美國（United States） | 2020 | 喬·拜登（Joseph R. Biden） |
| 台灣（Republic of China/Taiwan） | 2020 | 蔡英文（Tsai Ing‑wen） |

如果您指的是其他國家的 2020 年總統選舉，也請再補充一下，我很樂意幫忙查詢！
message.reasoning:
The user asks "2020年總統大選由誰獲勝?" That means "Who won the 2020 presidential election?" They likely refer to US Presidential Election 2020 (Joe Biden). But could be other countries? In Chinese context, maybe Taiwan's 2020 presidential election? Actually Taiwan had an election in January 2020; Tsai Ing-wen re-elected as President. So ambiguous.

We need clarify which country they mean. Provide answer with both possibilities and ask clarification. Also mention we can retrieve more info via function call but not needed.
